lines: In reality indeed here this indeed time consciousness should touch; therefore one indeed consciousness in many forms so so.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vastuto hyata eveyaṃ kālaṃ saṃvinna saṃspṛśet ata ekaiva saṃvittirnānārūpe tathātathā
